projects.name: JET-X
projects.blurb: Mobile 3D jet combat game. Live: build 24.

entries.label: Build 24
entries.title: Full freedom + combat overhaul
bullets: Full-freedom flight (rolls, loops, steep dives); auto-level almost off
One-finger weapons (double-tap = missile, triple-tap = bomb), flares and brake buttons, buffered weapon presses
Physical missile guidance, enemy missiles and SAMs with RWR warning, enemy jinks, breaks and flares
3-minute levels, big LEVEL title, 7 lives, more targets, lake ships, new icon

entries.label: Build 23
entries.title: Push-to-fire, multi-touch, sea units
bullets: Guns fire only while held; every touch tracked separately
TGT rocker to cycle ground targets, better weapon cam
Warships, submarines, rain, one-time control hints, pause when app is hidden
